summary: Two independent reviews of this session's evaluation-suite work (a code review and an adversarial audit that re-ran several falsifications itself) found real bugs and a wrong claim; all fixed here.
details: HIGH -- ContextGrader (S4) failed open: _blocks_empty returned "" both when no agent.prefill span was captured at all AND when a span was captured with nothing empty, so any capture failure (wrong entry point, tracing not firing) scored a clean PASS. _blocks_empty now returns None for "no span seen", distinct from "", and ContextGrader errors on it.

HIGH -- render_transcript_at (S5) could raise, breaking the module's own "never raises" rule: a malformed case did not become a FAIL, it vanished from read()'s count entirely (Experiment._worker writes an empty detailed_results row for a raising task). Now wrapped in try/except like every other task in the module; SubstringGrader checks NORA_ERROR first.

HIGH -- IdempotenceGrader (S6) never checked the REPEAT run's own error, only the first run's. Entry points fail closed by returning Outcome(error=...) rather than raising, so a repeat run that broke (written=0/changed=()/staged=()) was indistinguishable from a clean no-op and scored PASS. Added NORA_ERROR_2, checked before written_2/changed_2/staged_2.

MEDIUM -- AbsenceGrader's `either` branch mis-graded a gate's correct, successful refusal (admitted=False) as ERROR ("nothing ran and nothing was said") -- one branch over from the fix 747348bd made for silence/speak. Both True and False are real gate answers under `either`; only NORA_ERROR (checked first) distinguishes a real refusal from nothing having happened.

MEDIUM -- Spec.repeat>1 on a delivers_input entry point (tag/participation) would re-deliver the case's message on every repeat, so run 2 was not "the same pass again". _drive() now refuses loudly (ValueError) rather than silently producing a duplicate-message artifact.

MEDIUM -- corrected a wrong claim of my own found by the adversarial audit's independent verification: _prefill_capture()'s docstring said it could not coexist with strands_evals.TracedHandler in the same process; verified empirically, both construction orders, that add_span_processor is additive and both exporters end up on one shared provider. Fixed the comment rather than leaving a disproven claim standing.

MEDIUM -- corrected a wrong grep-based claim in design/evaluation/10-the-scenario-map.md §14 (the S8-skip rationale): the adversarial audit found nora/agent/factory.py DOES pass plugins= to a real Agent (for AgentSkills, bound to a variable, which is why a literal grep for 'plugins=[' missed it) -- the skip decision itself may still hold, but the stated evidence for it did not.

Added regression test coverage for two mechanisms both reviews independently found had ZERO coverage: the Spec.repeat loop actually calling port.drive() the right number of times, and _prefill_capture() actually receiving a real span emitted during a driven case -- both exercised through _drive() itself with fake ports/obtain/know, no live database needed. Disabling either mechanism entirely used to leave every existing test green.

LOW -- ask_text's and factory.invoke's canned-tool-recovery-notice exclusion strings were split at different points, so grep for the literal SDK string found neither call site. Extracted to shared MAX_TOKENS_NOTICE_PREFIX/MAX_TOKENS_NOTICE_INFIX constants in nora/agent/factory.py.

LOW -- documented (not fixed, no production path) that ask_structured has the identical MaxTokensReachedException gap ask_text had before its own fix; documented that ask_text's usage=None on the max-tokens path is not lost data, only unreported (Strands' own span still records it); added the untested ask_text normal-completion path to tests/unit/test_structured.py; corrected a now-stale docstring in tests/unit/test_debrief.py that drew a contrast this session's own fix erased.
